relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that the maximum activation efficiency of SP-C01 on PPARγ was 58.2 % of that of RSG, which is a partial agonist of PPARγ.

relationships.subject: SP-C01
relationships.evidence_quote: This indicates that SP-C01 can inhibit the phosphorylation of S273 in the liver, skeletal muscle, and adipocytes

relationships.subject: SP-C01
relationships.evidence_quote: SP-C01 achieved the same expression promoting effect as RSG on GLUT4 without relying on full activation of PPARγ.

key_findings: SP-C01 is a dual sEH inhibitor and PPARgamma partial agonist blocking Ser273 phosphorylation, with anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects in pain models.
